clips.title: The story
paras: Klockmort's Essentials is a summons carrying urgent word from the night elf Mathiel to his gnome friend, Klockmort Spannerspan. Unable to abandon his duties to travel to Dun Morogh, Mathiel enlists passing Alliance travelers to answer Klockmort's plea for help in Ironforge. The call directs adventurers into Tinkertown to prepare for a perilous venture into the irradiated halls of Gnomeregan.

Word travels far even in troubled times. When Klockmort Spannerspan found himself in need of bold allies for a mission into Gnomeregan, he reached out across the sea to his night elf acquaintance, Mathiel. Mathiel, bound to his own post, cannot journey to the mountain kingdom himself, but he refuses to leave his friend's plea unanswered. Instead, he appeals to capable Alliance adventurers visiting him on the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus to make the trek to Dun Morogh on his behalf.

Klockmort Spannerspan operates out of Tinkertown, the bustling refugee district of Ironforge where displaced gnomes have gathered since the catastrophic fall of their underground city. Amid the whir of gears and clouds of steam, Klockmort is formulating plans to retrieve vital machinery left behind in Gnomeregan's contaminated corridors. Taking Mathiel's referral leads adventurers directly to Klockmort's workshop, enlisting them in his reclamation efforts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A gnome friend, Klockmort Spannerspan, sent word to me from Ironforge. He tells me he needs help on a dangerous, but essential, mission into Gnomeregan, the once great gnome city now contaminated and filled with mad gnomes and their devices.
I must stay here, but my heart aches to help my friend. If you can go in my stead, then I would be much indebted to you.
You may find Klockmort in Tinkertown, in Ironforge.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I do! I do need help with a mission into Gnomeregan. And you're just the adventurer to do it!
